title: Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts: Violation Point Values and Zero-Tolerance List
content:
Violation point values for Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts are set per violation type in the level schedule. At present every level carries the same values.

| Violation type (what it covers) | Shop-Only Shopper | Full-Service Shopper | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Diamond |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Late delivery: a delivery completed more than the order's late threshold after its window | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Missing items, verified: a missing-item report verified against the checkout receipt | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Batch dropped: dropping a batch after accepting it | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Wrong address: handing an order to the wrong address | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Conduct complaint: a substantiated customer or store conduct complaint | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| Alcohol procedure: handing over alcohol without completing the ID scan | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |

Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond are the Full-Service Shopper Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond levels.

In this schedule the figure for each type is referred to by the type's name: "the level's late-delivery points", "the level's missing-items points", "the level's dropped-batch points", "the level's wrong-address points", "the level's conduct-complaint points" and "the level's alcohol-procedure points".

## Zero-tolerance violations

The following violations deactivate the account on the first substantiated occurrence, at every level: fraud, harassment, theft, alcohol handed to a minor, account sharing, and unsafe driving causing injury.

## Quick answers

- *Which type carries the most points?* Alcohol procedure, at 6 points on every level.
- *Is a dropped batch valued differently at Diamond than at Shop-Only Shopper?* No; the dropped-batch figure is 2 points on all six levels.
- *Does the zero-tolerance list differ between levels?* No; the six listed violations are the same on every level.
